frontmatter_snapshot.summary: True (classical) TWR values the portfolio at every external cash flow, forms simple wealth-ratio sub-period returns, and geometrically chain-links them; the unit-price (NAV) method is its variant, at the cost of accurate valuation at each flow.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: True Time-Weighted Return and Geometric Chain-Linking
